summary: 150053568350107_1482054053944877 feeds_service August 19, 2026 Cameco was pleased to host members of the Pinehouse Joint Implementation and Engagement Committee and local land users on a recent visit to our Key Lake Operation. Guests were given firsthand tours of our ongoing environmental monitoring and progressive reclamation activities. Highlights included a revegetation trial at a waste rock site, and the work of Pinehouse Business North in restoring a natural waterway channel at a one of our monitoring stations.
